—Galazeth Prismari

"Knowledge of the future can be a burden, but I'm not one to be weighed down."
"I'm a 22nd century Lyrate Life-form Approximation. I already know what you need before you do."

"Keep up, Spider-Man. We don't have all night!"

—Selvala
Travelers who have reached the headwaters of Fool's Fall say that strange serpents dwell in the waters there, though none can recall any more than that.
"All these childhood memories are getting in the way of the vault codes."

"Only a fool goes out there unprepared. If the heat doesn't get you, the time alone with your thoughts likely will."
—Ertha Jo, frontier mentor

Sagas sing of realms long forgotten, shattered by doomskars and cleaved violently from the World Tree.

"No one has heard Drivnod speak. But we have seen him do unspeakable things. As he drifts over Ish Sah, a deathly whisper rides the wind. I can never watch for long—I turn away and hide."
—Kara Vrist, resistance spymaster

"I paid a price to one I will not name to escape the abyss. A bit of my soul for a second chance. And I'd do it again, and again—until I had no soul left to trade."
—Tinua, Skirsdag cultist
"Art exposes truth. Each step of my dance brings me closer to the secrets of the universe."
"I'm not as quick as I used to be, but the wheat doesn't mind."
"Pah! You call this a comprehensive? I call this nest-stuffing!"
For every five you see, there are fifty you don't.
Each of them is a bad influence on the rest.

"Anyone can live next door, but when you fight to defend your neighbors, you become a village."
—Rho, veteran hero
The magic of the land is a thread that weaves all of Valley into a tapestry, connecting even the most distant of friends.

"It started as a prototype for a frog diving suit, but the internal mechanisms didn't leave room for the frog."
—Fitzwhisker, otterfolk inventor
The group called the Benefactors offers what aid and protection it can to other survivors, marking precious safe zones with the sign of the flame.
Even those who think they have nothing have something left to lose.

He turns every room into a crematorium.
Survivors who stay together, slay together.

"Nothing I beat down stays down. I love this place!"
—Tyvar

"Cyclical as the passing of days, the fiend would return again. And like the sun rising, so would a champion to slay it."
—*Heroics: A Book of Fables*
Sailors swear by the Sphinx's stars, which always seem to point the way home.

"I freely trade away my breaths, for the only one I must keep is my last."
—Sopia, Skelle cleric
"Follow me. I know these hills like the back of my stabbing knife."

"Hello again, my metamorphic friends. What stories have you brought to tell me today?"

—Memorial inscription

"The Way tells us we must strive towards unity of mind. Through shared understanding, we may yet put an end to strife on Tarkir."

—Neriv

"This was where I fought my first battle under Kolaghan. How I have outgrown her."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

"We remember all the world has endured, everything it has gone through to bring us to today. We are proud of Tarkir."
—Betor
In the mist, turbulent enough to deafen. Beneath the boughs, serene enough to soothe.

"I came here often to meditate on Ojutai's teachings. Now, I must also consider his failings."
—Narset
Where dragonlords once schemed, their memory now dissipates.

—Maralen, fae ascendant

Lasting beauty is to give more than you take.

—The Spot, Johnathon Ohnn

"Evil never dies. It just becomes bees."
—Swarm, Fritz von Meyer
"I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."

New York City's rat problem disappeared overnight.
Sinner takes all.
"You fool! You thought you had won?"
"You're a menace and a crook, Spider-Man! Jameson was right!"

"Hey Max, while you're at it, do you mind charging my phone?"

"Spiders don't hold still given any other choice, and I have all the choices in the Multiverse!"

"Alrighty, let's see who's behind the mask this time. Kingsley, is that you?"
—Spider-Man
"The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."
Neither criminals nor veterinarians had much luck pinning down the uncatchable Spider-Cat.

"As if one goblin wasn't bad enough."
—Spider-Man

"Face it, tiger. You just hit the jackpot!"
—Mary Jane Watson
"It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."
If you're going to have a gimmick, embrace it.
Mock him at your peril.
At the edge of the Spider-Verse, a Gwen Stacy becomes a hero.

"We've done it, Professor Warren. The glorious metamorphosis of Manhattan has begun!"
—Spider-Queen, Adriana Soria
"Disrespect authority. Smash the system."
Every Spider ever...and then some!
"It isss my intention to return the dinosaur to hisss rightful place as master of thisss earth."

"I got two speeds, buddy: fast and off duty."

"We got two hours until Spidey's webbing dissolves. I need engineers on-site now."

"Any of you! One-on-one! No one can stay in the ring for three minutes with me!"
—Crusher Hogan

"Ow! A spider! It bit me! But why is it glowing that way?"
—Peter Parker
"Nothing like a little crimefighting after class."
On Earth-66, Pter Ptarker learned that with GRRRR power comes GRRAHHHsibility.

"Te amamos, mijo."
—Rio Morales

"Hey, Miles! Are you busy at the moment?"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker
With the proportionate strength and stickiness of a spider, Spider-Man can scale skyscrapers with ease.
"We love you, Spider-Man!"
The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.
"Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!"

"People cheer for that webbed menace. They should be cheering for my son."
—J. Jonah Jameson

"The Green Goblin lives again!"
—Green Goblin, Harry Osborn
For Professor Miles Warren, all any problem needs is a lot of clones and not a lot of ethics.
The hunter seeks only the greatest prey—only Spider-Man's death will quench Kraven's thirst for glory.
"I have found honor, not in the civilized, but in the primal."
Charismatic and confident, Mary Jane was born for the limelight.
"Light and dark. They are in opposition, but both are necessary. I am both, and so I am all."

"Hurry up before the bug gets here!"
—Hammerhead
"Nothing matters—except the ravening thirst of Morbius! A thirst which must be quenched!"
"It's nothing personal, kid. It's just money."

"Happy Halloween, Spider-Man!"
—Green Goblin, Norman Osborn

"I'm Rhino. I knock things down. That's what I do. That's who I am."
—Rhino, Aleksei Sytsevich
Spider-Man wasn't looking to fight, but that was all Rhino wanted.
Those who cross Kaine are forever marked.
Exposure to the Darkforce dimension left Frances Barrison craving chaos and carnage.

"What would Uncle Jonah do if he saw me now?"
—Spider-Woman, Mattie Franklin
Some spiders feed on *other* spiders.
On Earth-982, May "Mayday" Parker, the first child of Peter and Mary Jane, continues her father's legacy.
"That's why I do what I do. For my people."
To know her is to fear her.
Dr. Johnathon Ohnn had no problem breaking laws, physical or otherwise.
Breaking expectations and enjoying it.

"I will be Spider-Man. With my unparalleled genius, I shall become the *Superior* Spider-Man."
—Otto Octavius
Osborn's lust for power was nothing short of monstrous.
"For all that web-slinging, Spider-Man, you seldom look up."
Together, this group of amazing friends joined forces to mend the severed skeins across time and space.
Using tech impounded from her various arrests, Captain Yuri Watanabe took the law into her own hands.
No fight in New York City was more vicious than the battle over who made the best bagels.
Once powerful tools of science, Dr. Otto Octavius's mechanical arms became his most formidable weapons.

"You've murdered a mask, but you haven't murdered a man."
—Peter Parker
"One with everything, please."
The device crackled to life, the portal opened, and Gwen's allies across the Great Web poured forth.
Peter appreciated the powerful new suit sent by Tony Stark, but he soon found it came with some strings attached.

"This was cutting edge when I was a kid!"
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

"A man-made made man? You always knew how to get ahead, Silvermane."
—Spider-Man
"C'mon, we can't let Parker get all the shots of Spider-Man."

"Staten Island in peril? Uh, give me an hour?"
—Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy

"How does Parker get those close-ups?"
—J. Jonah Jameson

"Parker was a fool to waste his time on patrol. I'll have my spider-bots do it for me."
—Superior Spider-Man, Otto Octavius
With Johnny Storm's help, Spider-Man took the all-terrain vehicle to the next level.
"With each attempt on Spider-Man's life, my father came closer to ending the menace. It is my pleasure to finish the job."
Nothing beats the classic look.
"Heads up! It's time for a fast game of catch!"
Known as "New York's Finest Newspaper," the *Daily Bugle* takes pride in always being fair and impartial.
New worlds await...

"We believe each patient has their own unique path to healing."
—Dr. Ashley Kafka, Ravencroft Institute
Exotic trophies from victorious hunts adorn the walls of the Kravinoff estate.
Under the sea it stands the hidden headquarters of the Master Planner and his band of strangely-garbed criminals.

"You are always welcome here, Peter."
—Aunt May
The students and faculty of Empire State University are at the forefront of scientific research...and related pursuits.
For Peter, apartment hunting was about location, location, cost, and location.
If you can make it here, you can make it anywhere.
